baseline_models.mechanism: The ordinal fifth is a terminal utterance of a different kind: invocation of God couples a self-directed curse to possible falsehood, so the speaker adds liability rather than another assertion.

activation_trace.role: The literal fifth marks an ordinal threshold and gives the formula its terminal position.
Mutual or self-imprecation supplies the formal curse-bearing act and shifts the burden onto the speaker.
The divine name in oath usage makes the utterance an invocation rather than an ordinary claim.
Realized being under the conditional makes the sanction depend on the speaker's actual state.
Falsehood supplies the contingency that activates the self-imprecation.

changed_reading.before: A fifth repetition that further asserts the accusation.
changed_reading.after: A terminal self-imprecation that adds personal liability rather than additional factual evidence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: لَعْنَتَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ
baseline_models.mechanism: The conditional maps membership among liars to expulsion from divine favor. The verse therefore assigns the risk of falsehood to the speaker without itself resolving the disputed fact.

activation_trace.role: Expulsion under displeasure supplies the consequence the speaker conditionally places upon himself.
Actual occurrence or state keeps the consequence contingent on what is really the case.
Attribution to lying frames the risk as the speaker's classification among liars.

changed_reading.before: A declaration that the accused is guilty and the speaker is true.
changed_reading.after: A conditional self-exclusion whose force depends on whether the speaker truly belongs among liars.

context_deltas.mechanism: The curse's expulsion image is bracketed by forgiveness, favor, and mercy. The fifth formula thus stakes access to an encompassing field of grace; it does not authorize the human audience to enact the invoked exclusion.

activation_trace.role: Expulsion from good or mercy names the loss conditionally risked by the speaker.
Covering the offense and shielding its bearer establishes restoration immediately before the oath sequence.
Merciful tenderness supplies the positive field from which curse would expel.
Gracious giving frames the paired self-imprecations as contained within divine beneficence.
Mercy immediately after the reciprocal formulas prevents curse from becoming the section's final register.

structural_cues: 24:5 places forgiveness and mercy immediately before the spouse-oath sequence.
24:10 follows the two fifth formulas with favor, mercy, and divine turning.
24:14 and 24:20 repeat the favor-and-mercy refrain around the false-report sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a lexical opposition between expulsion from mercy and repeated mercy; I infer that the speaker risks loss of that field while the sanction remains divine. A live alternative is that the mercy refrains frame the section generally without modifying the oath's force.

changed_reading.before: The speaker asks for an isolated punitive curse.
changed_reading.after: The speaker conditionally risks exclusion from the mercy that surrounds the procedure, leaving execution and final judgment with God.

context_deltas.mechanism: Four attestations state a truth claim; the fifth switches from testimony to self-sanction. The wife's mirrored four-plus-fifth sequence and its stated blocking of punishment show that 24:7 is the male side of a reciprocal liability mechanism, not a fifth evidentiary witness.

activation_trace.role: The ordinal fifth marks the point at which the speech act changes category.
Formal mutual imprecation supplies the sanction that replaces another truth assertion.
The literal four fixes the preceding evidentiary count against which the fifth is contrastive.
Knowledge-bearing attestation supplies the repeated speech units before the sanction threshold.
Truth of speech identifies what the four attestations assert, distinguishing them from the fifth's consequence.
Her knowledge-bearing attestations mirror his repeated statements and establish procedural reciprocity.
Her literal four reproduces the same count before her distinct fifth formula.
Punitive pain names the immediate liability that her reciprocal sequence blocks.
The second literal fifth confirms a mirrored terminal threshold.
Intensified displeasure supplies her corresponding self-sanction and exposes the reciprocal design.

structural_cues: 24:6 gives four attestations before the focus ayah.
The branchless 24:8 verb د ر ء explicitly states that her response wards off punishment.
24:8-9 mirror the four-plus-fifth architecture while changing the fifth from curse to anger.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies numerical, grammatical, and sanction symmetry; I infer a threshold from testimony to reciprocal self-liability. A live alternative is that the fifth merely intensifies an otherwise uniform series of oaths.

changed_reading.before: The fifth is the strongest of five equivalent attestations.
changed_reading.after: The fifth is a category switch: four claims are followed by a reciprocal self-sanction that carries procedural liability.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later false-report sequence depicts ungrounded speech passing cheaply from tongues to mouths and spreading socially. The fifth self-curse makes an accusation costly at its point of origin by concentrating the risk of falsehood back onto its speaker.

activation_trace.role: Falsehood is the focus condition whose social transmission the context makes dangerous.
Expulsion under displeasure gives the originating speaker a personal cost for false speech.
A lie turned away from truth supplies the contextual instance of socially consequential false report.
The tongue as speech organ supplies the first relay in the report's low-friction transmission.
The opened mouth in speech supplies the public outlet through which the ungrounded claim travels.
Knowledge as disclosure marks what the circulating speakers lack and what solemn form cannot manufacture.
Treating the matter as light supplies the low perceived cost that the self-curse reverses.
Spread and diffusion supply the collective harm that a speaker-bound sanction can help contain.
Transgression beyond proper bounds identifies what the spreading report amplifies.

structural_cues: 24:11-19 repeatedly tracks hearing, speaking, lack of knowledge, perceived triviality, and social spread.
The focus ayah directs the consequence inward with عَلَيْهِ rather than outward toward the accused.
The conditional preserves uncertainty while attaching a cost to originating the claim.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies false report, mouth-to-mouth transmission without knowledge, and spread; I infer that self-imprecation functions as a speech-containment cost at the source. A live alternative is that the oath procedure and the communal rumor episode remain parallel warnings without this causal relation.

changed_reading.before: The curse only heightens private sincerity between spouses.
changed_reading.after: The curse also contains socially mobile accusation by making its originator personally answerable for falsehood.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah later joins the focus ayah's two poles: claimants without four witnesses are classed as liars before God, and verbal assailants of protected women are cursed. The focus fifth becomes a conditional act of placing oneself into that very culpable class if the accusation is false.

activation_trace.role: Attribution to lying supplies the class into which the speaker conditionally places himself.
Expulsion under displeasure supplies the consequence attached to that conditional class.
The literal four marks the ordinary witness threshold whose absence activates the liar classification.
Knowledge-bearing witnesses supply the missing public basis against which unsupported speech is judged.
Contextual attribution to lying explicitly names the status risked in the focus conditional.
Casting through speech supplies the accusatory act whose consequence returns to a false speaker.
Protected sexual integrity identifies the guarded person whom unsupported accusation breaches.
Actual expulsion under displeasure supplies the later class consequence anticipated conditionally in 24:7.

structural_cues: 24:13 places unsupported claimants among liars before God.
24:23 assigns curse to those who accuse protected women.
24:7 conditionally joins lying status and curse in one self-directed formula.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the same lying class and curse consequence in later accusation contexts; I infer that 24:7 lets the speaker conditionally self-classify within that pattern. A live alternative is a thematic echo rather than exact identity between the legal classes.

changed_reading.before: The speaker invokes a generic curse if his sentence is false.
changed_reading.after: The speaker conditionally places himself among the surah's cursed verbal assailants if he lacks truth behind the accusation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The speaker's chosen oath is provisional testimony under divine audit. Later, tongue, hands, and feet testify about deeds and full recompense exposes manifest truth; invoking God's curse therefore transfers unresolved truth from controlled speech to an eventual witness system the speaker cannot control.

activation_trace.role: The divine name in oath usage places the contested claim before a divine audit horizon.
Possible falsehood is the unresolved status that later testimony will expose.
The witnessing tongue literalizes testimony becoming an involuntary bodily disclosure.
The speech organ becomes an independent witness rather than merely the speaker's instrument.
The bodily hand expands testimony beyond verbal assertion.
The bodily foot completes a multi-organ witness field outside conscious rhetorical control.
Intended deeds provide the underlying record against which chosen speech is audited.
Full completion without deficiency supplies the audit's eventual settlement.
Reckoning and recompense supply the consequence horizon invoked by self-curse.
Reality-matching truth supplies the outcome that replaces disputed human assertion.

structural_cues: 24:24 moves testimony from chosen speech to tongue, hands, and feet.
24:25 immediately joins full recompense to recognition of manifest truth.
24:7 invokes God while leaving the truth condition grammatically open.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies future embodied witnesses, deeds, recompense, and manifest truth; I infer that the fifth oath appeals to that uncontrollable verification horizon. A live alternative is that the later judgment scene generalizes beyond this procedure without specifically interpreting it.

changed_reading.before: The fifth oath closes the truth question through the speaker's own words.
changed_reading.after: The fifth oath hands the still-open truth question to a divine audit in which even the speaker's body can testify.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later command not to swear, despite maximal oaths, separates verbal intensity from known obedience and divinely known action. The fifth formula therefore cannot manufacture knowledge or prove truth by solemnity; it raises the speaker's exposure if his claim is false.

activation_trace.role: The counted fifth supplies formal escalation whose epistemic limits the later oath scene exposes.
The divine name in oath usage supplies solemn invocation without itself converting assertion into knowledge.
Distributed oath-taking supplies the explicit later case where swearing is refused as sufficient performance.
Maximum exertion under difficulty supplies oath intensity and shows that intensity still does not establish truth.
The explicit oath literal supplies the comparison with the focus invocation.
Actual obedience supplies the behavior preferred over amplified oath speech.
Knowledge of reports and inner reality supplies the divine awareness that tests oath against actuality.
Intended action supplies the reality known by God beyond the verbal form.

structural_cues: 24:53 juxtaposes strenuous oaths with the command not to swear.
The same ayah substitutes recognizable obedience and closes with divine knowledge of action.
24:7 is conditional rather than a narrator's certification of the speaker.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a direct contrast between maximal oath speech and known action; I infer that 24:7's fifth increases liability, not certainty. A live alternative is that 24:53 critiques insincere political oaths only and should not qualify this regulated spouse oath.

changed_reading.before: The fifth oath proves the accusation because no sincere person would invoke such a curse.
changed_reading.after: The fifth oath does not prove truth by solemn form; it exposes the speaker to consequence while truth remains divinely knowable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This spatial reading is surprising because it activates the wall sense of س و ر and fortress sense of ح ص ن rather than their immediate surface meanings. It remains anchored in the focus curse's explicit expulsion image and in the packet's guarded-person context. Downstream prose should present it only as a whole-surah spatial analogy, not as a lexical translation of سُورَة or مُحْصَنَات.

activation_trace.role: Expulsion under displeasure supplies the focus action as a possible self-banishment.
A raised enclosing wall supplies the surah-wide image of a bounded normative space.
Preservation inside an enclosing fortress supplies the protected status that false accusation breaches.

changed_reading.before: The curse is an inward spiritual penalty detached from the surah's spatial order.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the false accuser conditionally expels himself from the guarded order whose boundaries protect persons and reputations.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates the proverb-like deceptive-fifths image and the garment-that-lies-by-appearance image. Both are anchored directly in focus roots, and 24:53 independently distinguishes maximal oath form from known action. Downstream prose must call it a diagnostic analogy, not a claim that the fifth means deception or that this speaker is necessarily lying.

activation_trace.role: The deceptive 'fives for sixes' image makes counted form a possible vehicle of misdirection.
A garment that lies by its appearance supplies the analogy of solemn form clothing an unverified claim.
Explicit oath-taking later refused as sufficient supports the distinction between formal display and truth.
Knowledge of inward reality supplies the audit that can see through rhetorical clothing.

changed_reading.before: The fifth's extreme solemnity makes deceptive performance impossible.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, even the fifth can clothe falsehood in legal form; its safeguard is heightened liability, not immunity from performance.

strongest_changes: The mirrored four-plus-fifth sequences turn the focus from a fifth testimony into a threshold from assertion to reciprocal self-sanction.
Later liar and curse passages make the conditional formula a possible self-classification among culpable verbal accusers.
Embodied testimony and the later rejection of maximal oath display prevent solemn form from being mistaken for proof.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context made 24:7 read less as an isolated curse and more as a controlled transfer of unresolved evidentiary risk into reciprocal, divinely audited self-liability.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the contrast between curse in 24:7 and anger in 24:9 carries a distinct mechanism beyond mirrored sanction.
Whether the repeated mercy refrains alter the temporal force of curse or only frame the broader section.
How much weight downstream prose should give the spatial-boundary and camouflage analogies.
